title: Meet Approach S72: Garmin’s ultimate golf smartwatch
summary: Garmin today unveiled its new flagship golf smartwatch, Approach® S72, a premium, feature-rich companion on the course.
body_markdown:
OLATHE, Kan./Oct. 6, 2026/PR Newswire – Garmin (NYSE: GRMN) today unveiled its new flagship golf smartwatch,[Approach® S72](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/p/1937140/) , a premium, feature-rich companion on the course that also provides advanced health and wellness features for everyday wear. Available in two sizes – 43mm and 47mm – with bright AMOLED displays, the smartwatch includes a new lightweight ComfortFit fabric band, titanium bezel and sapphire lens to ensure all-day comfort and durability. With biometric data1, including real-time heart rate, golfers can gain a better understanding of how their heart rate changes before and after each shot. What’s more, Approach S72 adds on-wrist swing metrics to help players implement changes to their swing based on real data rather than just feel.


Players also have access to a new feature to give them a better understanding of green contour data. With an active Garmin Golf Membership™,golfers can see what direction putts will break and the average slope percentage on select courses, making it quicker and easier to determine their aim point.


*“We’re excited to introduce the next generation of golf technology with Approach S72 and help golfers better understand their whole game. From biometric data and swing metrics to advanced golf features and everyday smartwatch tools, Approach S72 gives avid golfers the insights they need to take their game to the next level. It’s everything players would want in a golf watch and an everyday smartwatch.” –Susan Lyman, Garmin Vice President of Consumer Sales and Marketing*


## **New features for the course**


- **Golf biometric data:** Look back on a completed round and see trends in how heart rate may have impacted the score1.
- **Swing metrics:** Golfers can receive advanced insights into their swing with swing metrics, including hand speed, backswing length, wrist rotation and more.
- **Green reading:** Golfers can be more confident in their aim point with the green reading feature on select courses, which uses green contour data to make it easier to find the line2.
- **Driving range activity:** Not only track swing metrics and learn tendencies but also log driving range activities into the Garmin Connect™ app, so players’ practice sessions contribute to their fitness goals.
- **Putting analytics:** Receive insights in the Garmin Golf app following a round on speed bias, direction bias, make rate and more to help evaluate strengths and weaknesses on the green2.
- **Aerial imagery:** Get an enhanced view of the shot ahead with real imagery of the hole to make more informed decisions about where to layup, the best place to miss and more2.


## **Built for all-day wear**


- **Premium build:** Constructed with a lightweight titanium bezel that won’t hinder a golf swing, the device also features a sapphire lens for durability and a ComfortFit fabric band to ensure a perfect fit on the golfer’s wrist.
- **Speaker and microphone:** Make and take phone calls and perform basic tasks – on and off the course – with voice commands on Garmin’s first golf smartwatch to offer these attributes.
- **Built-in flashlight:** Find equipment in the golf bag or illuminate a dark area with a flashlight with variable intensities of white light and a red light.
- **Battery life:** Play multiple rounds without needing to re-charge as the larger smartwatch boasts up to 20 hours of battery life on the course and up to 16 days when the GPS is turned off.


## **Maximize performance**


Designed for wear both on and off the links, the Approach S72 includes many top-tier fitness features to help golfers improve their overall health and reach peak form each round. Players can get a complete health picture with wrist-based heart rate, stress tracking, Body Battery™ energy monitoring, advanced sleep monitoring and more1. The smartwatch also includes a full complement of preloaded activity profiles to help players work on their strength and mobility.


The Approach S72 golf smartwatches are available now with suggested retail prices starting at $799.99. Learn more about Garmin’s full lineup of golf products[here](http://garmin.com/golf) .


Engineered on the inside for life on the outside, Garmin products have revolutionized life for adventurers, athletes, off-road explorers, road warriors and outdoor enthusiasts everywhere. Committed to developing products that enhance experiences, enrich lives and help provide peace of mind, Garmin believes every day is an opportunity to innovate and a chance to beat yesterday.
